i1.title: Salvatore Ferragamo Signorina Misteriosa Eau de Parfum 100ml Gift Set with Body Lotion and 10ml Travel Spray
i1.descriptionHtml:
Blackberry and tuberose wrapped in dark vanilla: Signorina's mysterious side.

Salvatore Ferragamo Signorina Misteriosa Eau de Parfum 100ml Gift Set with Body Lotion and 10ml Travel Spray brings together Signorina Misteriosa Eau de Parfum in the full 100ml size, a 10ml travel spray and a matching body lotion. Wild blackberry and neroli open, creamy tuberose and orange blossom form the heart, and it settles into black vanilla and patchouli.

  • Heart: Tuberose, Orange Blossom
  • Base: Vanilla, Patchouli

  • A juicy blackberry and neroli opening
  • A creamy tuberose and orange blossom heart
  • A dark, warm vanilla and patchouli base
  • Travel spray and body lotion included

Blackberry and neroli first, then tuberose and orange blossom, finishing with vanilla and patchouli.
